tools.name: analyze
tools.description: Returns instructions to install HefestoAI and run `hefesto analyze` locally. This hosted endpoint does not analyze code: any code or language you pass is ignored and nothing is executed or stored.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "analyze" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Analyze a code snippet for quality issues and semantic drift" → after: "Returns instructions to install HefestoAI and run `hefesto analyze` locally. This hosted endpoint does not analyze code: any code or language you pass is ignored and nothing is executed or stored."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
